architectural_units.name: User
architectural_units.description: An individual or entity that interacts with the system, can be a donor or a company.

architectural_units.name: Security Service
architectural_units.description: Functions as a reverse proxy and load balancer, managing HTTP and HTTPS request routing.

architectural_units.name: System Service
architectural_units.description: Serves the web application and interacts with the database and external services.

architectural_units.name: Data Service
architectural_units.description: Provides the relational database for storing application data.

architectural_units.name: Traefik
architectural_units.description: Reverse proxy and load balancer tool used to implement the Security Service.

architectural_units.name: Next.js
architectural_units.description: Framework used to implement the System Service.

architectural_units.name: PostgreSQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database management system used to implement the Data Service.

architectural_units.name: Docker
architectural_units.description: Platform used to manage the execution of containers for the services.

architectural_units.name: Prisma
architectural_units.description: ORM used to manage database queries between the System Service and Data Service.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: External cloud storage service used by the System Service.

architectural_units.name: Stripe
architectural_units.description: External payment processing service integrated with the System Service.

architectural_units.name: Brevo
architectural_units.description: External email service connected to the System Service.

architectural_units.name: Sentry
architectural_units.description: External error monitoring service used by the System Service.

architectural_units.name: Google Analytics
architectural_units.description: External analytics service implemented in the System Service.
The Security Service (Traefik) manages the routing of HTTP and HTTPS requests towards the System Service (Next.js).
The System Service communicates with the Data Service (PostgreSQL) using Prisma as ORM.
The System Service interacts with several external services: Amazon S3, Stripe, Brevo, Sentry, and Google Analytics.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Security Service manages the routing of HTTP and HTTPS requests.

architectural_units.description: Security Service manages the routing of HTTP and HTTPS requests.

patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: The architecture implemented for the development of the Revivack project system is a microservices-based architecture.

patterns.name: Component-Based
patterns.description: The Component-Based pattern focuses on building the user interface by creating independent and reusable components.

patterns.name: Observer Pattern
patterns.description: The Observer pattern establishes a one-to-many relationship between objects, where a subject maintains a list of observers.

patterns.name: Singleton Pattern
patterns.description: The Singleton pattern ensures that a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to that instance.
